notes: Phase 2 of pre-commit review fixes: Memory & Lifecycle Cleanup. Implemented via TDD. 15 new tests: 5 CanvasRenderer dispose tests (P2.1-P2.5) in RenderingTest.html, 10 drop handler cleanup tests (P2.6-P2.15) in new FileDropHandlerTest.html. Fixed: (1) Canvas GPU memory not released on dispose — added canvas.width=0/height=0; (2) Global drop listeners never removed — both FileDropHandler and createFileHandlers now return cleanup functions; (3) Lifecycle cleanup wired with proper ordering. World-review identified 4 additional issues: race condition in cleanup order (fixed: drop listeners removed first), visual feedback leak (fixed: drag-over class removed in cleanup), rAF leak after dispose (fixed: _disposed flag), duplicate setup guard (fixed: auto-cleanup previous listeners). All 677 tests pass (1 pre-existing SaliencyDebugOverlayTest failure unrelated).
